updates.note: Management reaffirmed the order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
updates.quote: Given the strength of our opportunity pipeline and the underlying market dynamics, we remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the current year.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
updates.quote: For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the PPM portfolio EBITDA margin target around 7.8% for FY27.
updates.quote: In line with our Revenue growth guidance, we continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the working capital guidance of around 10% for FY27.
updates.quote: Factoring in the expected utilization of customer advances and increased vendor payments as the execution accelerates in H2, we are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.
